items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: What's his name was one of the guys that wrote -- I mean, put the music together, Sonny Blunt was his name, Sun Ra.

ctx.x: Well, we had two or three different people doing the writing then. Leon Washington wrote some for us, and then there was a fellow by the name of Hicks, trumpet player, and he was a very good arranger. So he wrote a lot of the things. See, the dance things and things like that.

And then, the show, they had their own arranger for the show. He would come in and rehearse with them, and then write a thing. What's his name was one of the guys that wrote -- I mean, put the music together, Sonny Blunt was his name, Sun Ra.
